notes: Rulebook built from derive-class-brief (138 rules kept, 11 parked). Trace phase_sha for all three phases matched the live body (strip+newline sha), so the cached trace was reused and bound. Teaching moment lands: Phase 2's two-places floor and example-of-good are in the fence, so the single-miss push-back cannot be skipped by a fast operator. The strategy doc has no explicit APT101 mood paragraph (only the Big Idea, whats-actually-true.md L5); the contract is derived from the Day 2 beat sheet and the trace. Rule question, not a finding: check_workshop 14/16 ask a trainer guide to carry room size and protected beat, and APT101 has no trainer guide yet. Rule question: check_prompts 45 says never deeper nesting than module-N/, but module-2/morning-agent/morning.md is set by the reused personal-agent-homework-2.
